decided_on_basis: Career clock date when the user gave the rule (October 2026 in the real calendar).
text: Wade accepts every USA Basketball senior national-team invitation unless he is injured on the invitation date. Nothing stops the career clock for an invitation; the user may change this rule at any time by a new dated record.

related_premises.usa_selection: Simulated committee: USA Basketball picks from USA-eligible players by simulated NBA production and standing, the same rule for every player; Wade is invited only if his simulated career earns it. Other countries play their real rosters.
related_premises.scope: The engine plays every game of every tournament under FIBA rules.
related_premises.athens_2004: The 2004 Olympic tournament (August 2004) passed before the pipeline existed: no selection for Wade and no games are recorded for it.
